messages:
Nina M.: Deloitte returned the SIG; urgent asks: INT-4 (data retention policy + deletion proof), ENC-3 (at-rest KMS proof), ID-5 (service account lifecycle). They want file-level evidence and a single upload link.

Carlos R.: Can we bundle a short retention matrix CSV, KMS key-rotation excerpt, and a list of service account names (redacted) with creation/deactivation dates?

Asha T.: I can export retention matrix and scrub tenant IDs. For service accounts I'll provide a csv with aliases and lifecycle dates, redacting principal ARNs.

OpsBot: Use Evidence Portal: generate presigned S3 link. Links expire in 7 days. All access is audited in evidence-audit.

Nina M.: Timeline: Deloitte wants the initial bundle tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Can Security/Docs deliver by then?

Carlos R.: I'll prepare ENC-3 artifacts: kms-rotation-snippet.txt and a short diagram (kms-boundary.svg). Will redact ARNs.

Asha T.: Retention matrix and service-accounts_v1.csv will be uploaded. I'll include sha256 checksums and manifest mapping SIG IDs to filenames.

Nina M.: OpsBot, please create link and set retention 14 days. Also need download audit access for Deloitte procurement.

OpsBot: Presigned URL: https://evidence.redwood-inference.internal/sig/1769502468?token=abc123 (expires 7d). Retention set 14 days. Audit logs available to procurement.

Carlos R.: Uploaded kms-rotation-snippet.txt and kms-boundary_v1.svg.

Asha T.: Uploaded retention-matrix.csv, service-accounts_v1.csv, and manifest_1769502468_v1.json. Checksums included.

Nina M.: Sent to Deloitte with walkthrough invite for Friday 13:00 UTC. Legal flagged the offline audit question for Private deployments; they need a short contractual statement. Pinged Legal.

Carlos R.: Noted. We'll version files as _v1 and keep diffs for future requests.

Nina M.: Thanks team, closing for now. If Legal replies I'll append the clause to the bundle.
